items.title: sparq-solid: memoize the resource set + ancestry closure (invariant under ACL writes)

labels.name: self-improvement
labels.description: Agent-discovered out-of-scope work for the self-improvement triage lane

items.body:
Impl child 2 of the sq-nmx4l design record (`research/solid-scoped-materializer-design.md` §5.5/§8).

`put_acl`/`delete_acl` change only a control graph. `assemble_facts` excludes control graphs from the resource set, and a `.acl`'s target `R` is a resource only if it independently exists as a content graph or container prefix. So the `solidx:isResource` fact set — and hence the whole `common.n3` `parent`/`ancestor` closure — is invariant under an ACL write, yet is recomputed on every one. `common.n3` itself documents that this closure is the part that goes quadratic if seeded wrong.

Cache it keyed by a fingerprint of the resource set, with a test pinning the invariance under `put_acl`/`delete_acl`. Correctness-trivial, system-independent (WAC and ACP), independently measurable — and it may be the larger share of the write-path cost, so measure it on the bench harness before assuming pod-scoping is where the time goes.

> 🤖 Discovered by the SPARQ worker while implementing #2852. Out-of-scope for that PR; captured as follow-up.
<!-- sparq-followup:v1 -->

items.title: [upstream] Upstream the IRI suffix-validation fast-path primitive (resume-from-verified-prefix) to oxiri, memo ring as optional utility
items.body:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Part of the maintainability program (see umbrella issue; multi-agent survey + independent verification, 2026-07-22).

## Evidence
/home/ubuntu/sparq/crates/sparq-core/src/iri.rs (482 LOC, opt-in iri-fast feature): a last-N accepted scheme://authority/ prefix memo + ASCII suffix pre-scan sitting in FRONT of oxiri's RFC-3987 automaton, accept-shortcut-only, with a mandatory differential-fuzz gate proving it accepts EXACTLY oxiri's language. oxiri is an already-used dep (direct optional + transitive via oxttl). The optimisation is generic to any oxiri consumer validating IRI-dense streams and the acceptance-equivalence proof makes an upstream PR credible.

## Proposal
File as a child of epic sq-98w7z (alongside the oxttl upstream bead sq-98w7z.3). Offer oxiri a minimal-diff PR in upstream style whose core is the small validation primitive — the position-independent safe-suffix byte class plus a "validate remaining suffix given an already-oxiri-validated scheme://authority/ prefix" API — with the IriPrefixMemo ring as an optional convenience on top (a pure caching wrapper alone is more likely to be declined). Target oxiri 0.3.x master (sparq is still on 0.2 — open issue #3688), so keep the in-tree iri-fast module as the shipped fallback until sparq migrates AND an upstream release absorbs the primitive. Before citing the acceptance-equivalence proof as the credibility basis in the upstream PR, close the CI-executor gap (#3547) so the differential-fuzz gate actually runs per PR. Follow the upstream contribution protocol: draft PR, tag @jeswr first.

## Related finding (merged)
**Upstream the prefix-memoized IRI-validation fast path (iri-fast) to oxiri as an opt-in memoized validator, riding the #3688 0.3 migration**
crates/sparq-core/src/iri.rs (482 LOC, feature iri-fast) is a self-contained ACCEPT-shortcut cache in front of oxiri: last-N proven scheme://authority/ prefixes + a vectorizable ASCII-safe-suffix table, with a differential-fuzz gate proving validate == oxiri exactly. It depends on nothing in sparq except oxiri itself. Open issue #3688 (oxiri 0.2→0.3 breaking migration) means this fast path must be re-verified against every oxiri bump for as long as it lives downstream.

Proposal: Offer crates/sparq-core/src/iri.rs (482 LOC, feature iri-fast, sq-7d3dj.18) upstream to oxiri as an opt-in memoized validator (last-N proven scheme://authority/ prefix ring + ASCII-safe-suffix scan, accepting byte-for-byte oxiri's language), or publish as a micro-crate depending only on oxiri if upstream declines. Living next to the automaton it shadows, the byte-exactness invariant is maintained upstream instead of via a downstream differential-fuzz gate re-run on every dependabot bump — a gate that today has NO CI executor at all (open issue #3547), so the invariant is currently unenforced between bumps. Do it as part of (or immediately after) the #3688 oxiri 0.2→0.3 migration to avoid porting the memo twice. Track as a child of epic sq-98w7z (upstream dependency program), following the sq-98w7z.3 pattern (measured win + minimal-diff draft PR in repo style, tag @jeswr first per the upstream contribution protocol).

## Acceptance
- The proposal above is implemented (or, for upstream items, a minimal-diff draft PR is opened upstream in repo style and @jeswr tagged first per the upstream protocol).
- No behavior change: existing tests/gates stay green in both feature states; byte-conventions changes (if any) update their exact-match tests as named above.
- Duplicated sites are deleted, not deprecated; a mutation tripwire or test guards against re-divergence where the proposal names one.

_Effort: small · Category: upstream-existing_

items.title: [EPIC] maintainability program: upstream, extract as libraries, consolidate duplication (2026-07-22 survey)
items.body:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

# EPIC: maintainability program — upstream, extract, consolidate (survey 2026-07-22)

Maintainer directive: make maintainability an overall goal of the codebase. A 44-agent survey swept all 54 crates + scripts/CI across three lenses — (1) logic that belongs in an existing upstream, (2) cohesive modules that could become standalone libraries under an appropriate upstream maintainer, (3) in-repo duplication to consolidate — and every finding below survived independent re-verification against the tree and dedup against the existing tracker (5 further findings were already tracked: sq-gg0qq.5/#2571 WAC engines, #3385 GML-SF geometry, sq-oy1f.36 sparq-jsonld publish, hdt#124 upstream, sq-4qo8 cyclonedx purl).

## Consolidate duplication
- #3693 — Consolidate Hinnant civil-date math into sparq-core::temporal (3 core sites now; ~12 more in-workspace copies as follow-up) _(small)_
- #3694 — Deduplicate the copy-pasted Levenshtein edit_distance into a tiny sparq-core module _(small)_
- #3695 — Single home for JSON string escaping: sparq_core::json_escape_into for the 3 consolidatable library copies (engine/reason/shacl) _(small)_
- #3701 — Two divergent Solid N3-Patch implementations (sparq-server vs sparq-lws-core): extract one shared parser/validator crate (crates.io candidat _(medium)_
- #3703 — Four independent Accept-header q-value parsers across sparq-server + sparq-lws-core; extract one wasm-clean shared media-range parse/match c _(small)_
- #3704 — brTPF position=term wire grammar duplicated across server parser and fedclient encoder with no shared code and no cross-crate round-trip tes _(small)_
- #3705 — Extract the shared secx:/sec-prop: IRI constants into a dependency-free leaf vocab crate (kills the sparq-zk cycle copy + its publish-breaki _(small)_
- #3709 — sq-tonhr endgame (the follow-up sq-tonhr.6 deferred): make sparq-shaclc the single product SHACL-CS parser; demote hand-rolled scs.rs to dif _(medium)_
- #3710 — Consolidate compressed open/dispatch (gz/bz2/zst) into a shared micro-crate used by sparq-cli and sparq-hdt _(small)_
- #3711 — site re-implements @jeswr/sparq's N-Triples parser: inference.ts verbatim-term parser duplicates js/src/sparql.ts _(small)_
- #3712 — Hand-rolled RFC-3986 percent-encoders duplicated at 8 sites across 6 crates; client/server pct_encode mirror pair drifts independently _(small)_
- #3714 — sparq-jsonld hand-rolls RFC 3986 reference resolution — the one resolver in the workspace not delegated to oxiri, with no differential gate  _(small)_
- #3715 — Consolidate the 8 copied W3C manifest-walkers in sparq-shacl's w3c_*.rs test runners into a shared tests/common module _(medium)_
- #3716 — Consolidate the three near-identical CI failure-filing scripts (differential / metamorph / demoted-lane) onto one shared filing library in s _(medium)_
- #3717 — Extract the committed-baseline ratchet idiom into scripts/lib/ratchet.py shared by the five gate scripts (staged: four --seed/--check gates  _(medium)_
- #3720 — Add local composite actions .github/actions/setup-rust and .github/actions/setup-playwright so each pinned setup SHA lives in exactly one re _(small)_
- #3721 — Factor the orphan-safe same-box bench scaffolding into scripts/lib/same-box.sh (two tiers: server teardown+ready-wait for the ~8 server harn _(medium)_

## Upstream to existing dependencies
- #3696 — Upstream the IRI suffix-validation fast-path primitive (resume-from-verified-prefix) to oxiri, memo ring as optional utility _(small)_
- #3700 — Consolidate four hand-rolled SPARQL-results (SRJ/SRX/TSV) client-side parsers onto one home; sparesults 0.3 (sparql-12) is already a version _(medium)_
- #3707 — sparq-reason N3 parser: route hand-rolled RFC 3986 resolve_iri through oxiri (already unconditionally compiled via the crate's non-optional  _(small)_
- #3708 — Replace sparq-mpc's owned ChaCha20 (chacha.rs) with the already-in-lockfile RustCrypto chacha20 crate (zeroize+rng features), keeping the RF _(small)_
- #3713 — Port zkp-ld rdf-canon to oxrdf 0.3 upstream and delete sparq-canon's double-parse N-Quads bridge + legacy oxrdf 0.2/oxttl 0.1 pins _(medium)_

## Extract as standalone libraries
- #3697 — Extract sparq-core's pure-id triple-permutation index layer (store.rs + compress.rs + extsort.rs) as a standalone crate _(large)_
- #3698 — Extract sparq-core's RDF term dictionary (dict.rs) as a standalone oxrdf-companion interning crate (e.g. rdf-term-dict), with the spill buil _(large)_
- #3699 — Extract sparq-vectors::diskann (persistent Vamana/DiskANN + .spqg format + PQ re-rank layer) into a stand-alone pure-Rust crates.io crate _(medium)_
- #3702 — Extract the hyper/tokio transport DoS-hardening layer (sparq-lws-core transport.rs) into a standalone acceptor-agnostic crate consumed by al _(medium)_
- #3706 — Extract the zero-dependency EYE/cwm-compatible N3 parser (sparq-reason/src/n3/{parser,model}.rs) into a publishable workspace crate _(medium)_
- #3718 — Publish sparq-difftest to crates.io as a standalone engine-independent XSD-value-canonical SPARQL results comparison library _(small)_
- #3719 — Extract the W3C rdf-tests manifest loader (sparq-conformance manifest.rs + rdf.rs/MiniGraph) as a publishable zero-sparq-dep crate over oxrd _(medium)_

All filed at priority:P3 (deliberately below the auto-dispatch cutoff): bump individual items to P2/status:ready to feed them to the fleet, or steer here. The graph-handling primitives the maintainer specifically asked about are the two large extractions (triple-permutation index layer + RDF term dictionary) plus the N3 parser and manifest-loader items.
